From the plates

Four photos guests posted on Google.

The name means “the hole”

Η Τρύπα is a small neighbourhood tavern in Agios Spyridon, Limassol: a grill, a bar counter, vines over the tables. Meat is grilled by the piece, so you order what you want and as much as you want, and a plate of meze sits in the middle of the table.

Open every evening from six until one.

From the guest book

Two of 50 Google reviews, 4.9 stars on average.

“The name says hole so don’t expect luxury. But you’ll get friendly Mr Kosta cooking some simple delicious high quality food. Come have a drink and a meze. This is original Greek Cypriot place.”
Alex Pappas · Google review
“Absolutely wonderful local tavern with a warm and authentic atmosphere! The food is incredibly fresh and perfectly cooked, preserving all its natural flavors. Every dish tastes like real, high-quality home cooking.”
Olga K · Google review
